en: Summary of the Chapter on Causes and the Following (*Hetuvārādiuddesa*)

Whatever wholesome states there are, all of them have wholesome roots … [and so on] … they have wholesome origins … wholesome sources … wholesome origins … wholesome arising … wholesome emergence … wholesome nutriment … wholesome objects … wholesome conditions … wholesome origin … [and so on].
origin and provenance; as well as origination, nutriment, and object.
“Condition by way of origination” is thus.
The section on enumeration is finished.
